data.narrative:
Harmattan AI is a Series B-stage defense and security company currently valued at $1.4B post-money, having raised $200M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $1.4B last post-money valuation, yielding $2.7B. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables (Dream Security at $3.0B, Code Metal at $1.2B, Castelion/Defense Unicorns/Heven AeroTech each at $1.0B) produces a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The stage-progression method suggests upside relative to current valuation; the peer-median suggests the current valuation sits above the cohort median.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $3.1B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The current $1.4B valuation sits below this median, implying modest upside. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer sample—particularly the wide $300M–$3.0B range—and whether public comparables adequately reflect private-market dynamics in frontier defense technology.
